entity.name: Antonio Leandro
entity.description: Software engineer in Recife, Brazil. Author and sole maintainer of OmniGet.

projects.name: OmniGet
projects.description: A free desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux that turns a link into a file. yt-dlp and gallery-dl run underneath, with a torrent client and 156 built-in tools for what comes after the download: transcribing, converting, reading and studying what you saved. No account, no ads, no telemetry on what anyone downloads. Files stay on the machine that fetched them.

channels.description: Bank transfer for grants and invoiced sponsorships. Details on request.

plans.name: A year of maintenance
plans.description: What it costs to keep OmniGet alive for twelve months: builds and code signing across three platforms, plus the constant repair of extractors as the sites they read change underneath them. One person does all of it.

plans.name: In-app sponsor
plans.description: Your logo on the About screen of the app itself, bundled with the binary so the page never calls home. 262,000 release downloads to date. Unlike a README, this is seen again every time someone opens the app, and no other project in this category sells it.

plans.name: README sponsor
plans.description: Your logo in the README, above the fold. 12,500 stars, and the most starred yt-dlp GUI on GitHub. For comparison, CodeRabbit pays ESLint $1,000 a month for the same kind of placement.

plans.name: Supporter
plans.description: For people who use OmniGet and want it maintained. Your name on the sponsors page.
